title: Samsung improves the power efficiency of the Exynos modems for the Galaxy S27 phones
description: Samsung’s Exynos-powered phones haven’t had the best reputation when it comes to standby power consumption – their modems tend to use more battery than the modems inside Snapdragon-powered Galaxy phones. But Samsung LSI may have finally cracked the problem. The M2700 modem, which will be used alongside the Exynos 2700 chipset in some Galaxy S27 models, promises better power efficiency, according to insiders who spoke to The Elec. “I understand that the M2700 achieved performance equivalent to or better than competitors' products through voltage adjustment and other measures,” said one...

title: Verizon's Straight Talk upgrades its unlimited plans without raising prices
description: Straight Talk, which is owned by Verizon, has announced upgrades for its Silver Unlimited, Gold Unlimited, and Platinum Unlimited plans, adding faster 5G Ultra Wideband access, more hotspot data, expanded international coverage, and Home Internet bundle savings. The monthly base prices stay the same, and the Silver Unlimited plan has been $45 per month since 2009, impressively. That plan now gets 5G Ultra Wideband access, 15GB of hotspot data (50% more than before), and unlimited international talk and text to Canada, Mexico, India, and China. Gold Unlimited, at $55 per month, also...

title: The iPhone Duo may not have a visible crease, but the display is soft in that area
description: The part of the iPhone Duo display that is above the hinge is squishy – this can be seen in a video originally posted by Weibo user Kang that was shared by Ice Universe. This is not entirely unexpected, but it’s still interesting to see. The perfectionists over at Apple couldn’t have a crease on their first-ever foldable. And to their credit, they engineered a solution – the crease is essentially invisible. This doesn’t mean that the strip over the hinge has solid backing, though. So, if you push it with your finger, it depresses slightly. Worse, Kang says that when pressing the screen...

title: Samsung Galaxy A36's One UI 9 update lands in Europe
description: Samsung started rolling out the update to Android 17 with One UI 9 on top to the Galaxy A36 last week, but it's only been available in South Korea. That has now thankfully changed, as the update is also rolling out in Europe. [#InlinePriceWidget,13497,1#] It arrives over-the-air as a 2.38GB download, so make sure you grab it over a fast enough network. After you install it, your Galaxy A36 will be on software version A366BXXUCDZIF, and the September 5, 2026 security patch level. The rollout is very likely to be gradual, so if you have an A36 purchased in Europe and you haven’t...

title: Doogee previews the Note60 W: a widescreen slab inspired by the Huawei Pura X View
description: Doogee previewed an interesting phone at the 140th Canton Fair – a widescreen slab phone that seems heavily inspired by the Huawei Pura X View. The Doogee Note60 W has a 6.38” display that seems to have the same 5:3 aspect ratio as the Pura X View. That one has a 6.39” display and while that sounds small, it measures 144.1mm tall and 87.0mm wide. For reference, the iPhone 18 Pro Max is 163.4mm tall and only 78.0mm wide. Doogee Note60 W The Doogee phone will have a 90Hz display and will come with Android 17 out of the box. It will pack a 6,500mAh battery inside an 8.4mm body,...

title: Samsung signs huge DRAM and HBM contracts
description: Samsung has reportedly signed a massive five-year long-term memory chip deal that will see the majority of its general-purpose DRAM and HBM memory chips go to “global big tech companies”. A new report from Yonhap News suggests that 70% of Samsung’s DRAM supply and a full 100% of the high-bandwidth memory (HBM) chips that are set to be produced next year are already reserved. The report also specifies “fierce competition” for the remaining 30% of Samsung’s DRAM orders. HBM chip prices are expected to jump between 150 and 200% next year, while DRAM prices are also expected to see a...

title: Shipping dates for the iPhone Duo have been pulled forward for many users
description: Apple got slammed with pre-orders for the iPhone Duo – the demand outstripped supply so badly that shipping dates around the world were quickly pushed back to January 22. But maybe the wait won’t be so bad as multiple users are reporting that their shipping dates have been pulled forward. If you have pre-ordered the iPhone Duo, have a look at the estimated shipping date – you may be in for a pleasant surprise. Ray Wong of Gizmodo says that many X users from Japan are seeing the initial November/December shipping estimates be pulled forward all the way to October 23 – that’s the official...

title: Oppo's wide-screen phone tipped to pack an 8,000mAh battery
description: Several details about Oppo’s rumored wide-screen smartphone have leaked over the past few weeks, with the latest one suggesting that it will feature a triple-rear camera setup with two 200MP sensors. A new leak has now revealed the phone’s battery capacity. Tipster Digital Chat Station has shared the full specifications of the Oppo wide-screen phone, which is rumored to be called the Reno X. According to the tipster, the phone will pack a battery with a capacity of up to 8,000mAh. This contradicts an earlier claim from the same tipster, who suggested that the device would feature a...

title: OnePlus details the dual-airflow fan design on the upcoming Ace 7 series
description: OnePlus has confirmed that the Ace 7 series will launch in China later this month. Alongside, a company executive has shared details about the dual-airflow cooling system featured in the upcoming lineup. While OnePlus has yet to announce an exact launch date, it teased the Ace 7 series launch in a short video on Weibo. The upcoming phones are said to bring major upgrades in performance and build quality over the Ace 6 lineup. OnePlus China President Li Jie has also shared a sketch of the upcoming phones’ rear design showcasing its new dual-airflow cooling system. The OnePlus Ace...

title: Apple is already working on a larger and better HomeView
description: Last week, Apple launched the HomeView, its first smart home screen thing, which is affixed to a speaker and rather obviously meant to compete with Amazon's Echo Show and Google's Nest Hub. The HomeView is basically Apple realizing it needs to be in this space and not cede it to its competitors without a fight. But it's not a perfect product. It seems to be designed to be appealing only to people who have all of the other Apple products, and somehow didn't buy any smart home devices from other ecosystems. That niche probably does exist and may be larger than you'd expect, but the HomeView...

title: Huawei Mate X8 specs leak
description: Huawei launched the Mate X7 in November of last year, and according to a new rumor from China, its successor, the Mate X8, is scheduled to become official next month. It will allegedly sport a 6.5-inch cover display, an 8.15-inch inner folding screen, a 50MP main camera using a 1/1.28" type sensor with variable aperture, a 50MP periscope telephoto camera, and a battery with a capacity of at least 6,000 mAh. Huawei Mate X7 The phone will reportedly be powered by the Kirin 9050 and Kirin 9050 Pro chipsets, with different versions of the phone getting one or the other. There will be a...

title: Apple to unveil new MacBook Pro models on October 28
description: Apple has announced its second special event for October, where it is expected to unveil the rumored touchscreen MacBook Pro. The company recently unveiled the HomeView, HomePod mini 2, a new Apple TV 4K, and several smart home products. The event is scheduled for October 28, with a special Apple Experience session set to take place in Los Angeles. Invite sent to YouTuber Marques Brownlee (@MKBHD) Invites for the event, which carries the tagline “Pro and tell”, were sent out to the press and media. Apple’s Greg Joswiak also confirmed the upcoming event on X. The use of “Pro” in...

title: Karbonn Rebel 5G is coming soon "for people who see past the hype"
description: Who remembers Karbonn? The Indian brand is preparing a comeback in the smartphone space, having spent the last five years or so in a state of hibernation. But that will end soon. There's a teaser microsite up on Amazon India for the upcoming Karbonn Rebel 5G. Unfortunately, the page doesn’t reveal any specs right now, but it does say things like "status isn't a specification", "style that stands out", "all of the phone, none of the price shock", and "don't follow, just rebel". The company says the Rebel 5G is "built for people who choose for themselves", "see past the hype", and...

title: New Realme phone gets listed before launch, here are its specs and price
description: The upcoming Realme C01 - not to be confused with the Realme C1 from 2018 - was recently spotted on certification platforms in Malaysia and the UAE with the model number RMX5399, and now a premature listing by a Vietnamese retailer reveals its official specs, images, and pricing, even though it's not available to buy yet. The phone comes with a 6.8-inch LCD screen with 720x1520 resolution, a 120Hz refresh rate, 900-nit peak brightness, and Panda Glass protection, the Unisoc T7250 chipset at the helm paired with 4GB of RAM and 64GB of storage expandable via a microSD card, an 8MP rear...

title: DCS: the Huawei Enjoy 100 Pro Max will have a bigger battery than its predecessor
description: Back in March, Digital Chat Station reported that the then-upcoming Huawei Enjoy 90 Pro Max would have an 8,500mAh battery. This leak was confirmed a few days later when Huawei made the Enjoy 90 series official. Now the leakster has the details for the next generation of Enjoy models. The Huawei Enjoy 100 Pro Max will have an 8,800mAh battery (typical capacity, rated capacity will be 8,560mAh), according to DCS. This is a 300mAh upgrade over its predecessor. There’s no word on charging, however (the Enjoy 90 series offered 40W wired-only charging). The Pro Max will feature an...

title: This is the upcoming Moto G47 Power
description: Last week we came across an EPREL listing for the upcoming Motorola Moto G47 Power, revealing its battery capacity, and we now have official-looking renders of the device alongside more of its key specs. Unsurprisingly, the Moto G47 Power looks a lot like the regular Moto G47, though at least one of its colorways is new, with a turquoise green color. The second one is the same black shade as before. Moto G47 Power renders According to the leaked specs, Moto G47 will feature the same 6.67" LCD with 1604 x 720px resolution and a 120Hz refresh rate. We also get confirmation that...

title: Xiaomi 18 Pro and Xiaomi 18 Pro Max European prices and battery capacities leak
description: If you thought the leaked European prices for vivo's X500 Pro and X500 Pro Max, or Oppo's Find X10 and Find X10 Pro Max were high, then you probably won't be ready for this. Today a new report claims to bring us the European prices for the Xiaomi 18 Pro and Xiaomi 18 Pro Max, and they are positively eye-watering. The Xiaomi 18 Pro with 256GB of storage is said to go for €1,449, while the 512GB version will set you back a whopping €1,649. title: Motorola's wide Razr Flex hits Geekbench with a surprising chipset
description: Last month, Motorola's upcoming wide foldable smartphone finally got a leaked name - it will allegedly be called the Razr Flex. This has now been confirmed through a Geekbench listing. Apparently, someone in possession of a prototype Razr Flex decided to run Geekbench 6.7.1 on it, thus confirming the name (as much as such a run can, of course - things like this can be faked). The benchmark run also revealed that the Razr Flex is powered by the Snapdragon 8 Gen 5 SoC, which is notable because past rumors have claimed it would have the Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5 instead. Anyway, the chipset is...

title: Leaked Galaxy S27 series cases reiterate new designs
description: The Galaxy S27 series is shaping up to be a turning point for Samsung’s flagship line. Previous rumors suggest Samsung will usher in a new design for its Galaxy S27 Pro and Ultra models while still offering the Galaxy S27 and larger-screen Galaxy S27+ as its more affordable entries. A new leak from IceUniverse gives us a fresh new look at cases for all four S27 models, and it seems the Pro and Ultra design is here to stay. title: The extra rugged Crosscall Core X7 surfaces at a French retailer, followed by a rugged tablet
description: One rugged phone and one rugged tablet have surfaced on French retailer AMG Pro, which focuses on selling tactical equipment. They come from Crosscall – another French company. The Crosscall Core X7 is a rugged handset that can survive submersion up to 2m of water for 30 minutes (IPX8 rating) – and this includes salt water, which most IP rated phones avoid. The phone is also dust tight (IP6X) and resists hot water jets (IP69K). It has been drop tested 300 times from 1.2m (following the MIL-STD-810H standard) and the manufacturer claims that it can actually survive falling from 2m onto...
